# Parser-owned type regions in call arguments

The original `cases.json`, `reference.json` and `FROZEN.json` were captured
before compiler changes using TypeScript 5.9.3. The implementation, three loaded
libraries, input bytes and complete expected outputs are hash-bound. The recorder
refuses to overwrite an existing authority.
The replay host and generated CLI configurations explicitly select LF on every
platform, preserving the original recorder's output bytes on Windows as well.

There are 34 original forms in four ES5/ES2022 and ESM/CommonJS profiles:
136 Native observations (108 accepts, 28 rejects), 216 Native declaration
consumers and eight Native executions. No original row is removed or rewritten.

The [P0-K contract](../../../../../development/browser_core/phase-18-bluets/ERASED_TYPE_REGIONS_CONTRACT.json)
selects 124 primary semantic observations (96 accepts, 28 rejects), requiring
exact declarations, complete diagnostics and positions, 192 positive/negative
consumers and eight executions on each actual CLI surface. Maps must decode and
reference valid owned UTF-16 coordinates. Every exact output/map difference is
retained separately; arbitrary exact Native mapping parity is not claimed.

`discovery-controls.json` preserves the accepted parent's complete BlueTS
diagnostics for three unrelated forms: the ambient-class constructor refusal
and two multi-variable declaration limitations. Their twelve original Native
acceptances remain visible. Inventory counts them as four refused and eight
open observations; they receive no P0-K repair credit. The field named
`acceptedParent` in this original discovery record contains the accepted
compiler's SHA-256; the Git parent is recorded by `FROZEN.json` and the contract.

The ordinary library test exercises all semantic/control rows and exact
accepted declaration bytes. The opt-in Native test additionally exercises both
CLI surfaces, owner receipts, complete output inventories, Acorn target syntax,
maps, isolated declaration consumers and actual executions. The approved
`unknown as T` return and existing readonly mutation refusal remain controls.
The callable-type argument regression reuses the original frozen
`callable_utilities` program and Native diagnostic; it adds no case denominator.

Future tuple-length and conditional-contravariance repairs are separate work
packages. This fixture does not establish broad feature parity.
